round( stat.desc(anxiety_data$Exam), 2)
cor( anxiety_data$Anxiety, anxiety_data$Exam, method="spearman" )
table(anxiety_data$Gender)

is.factor(anxiety_data$Gender)

is.factor(anxiety_data$Gender)
is.numeric(anxiety_data$Anxiety)

by(anxiety_data$Anxiety, anxiety_data$Gender, mean)
by(anxiety_data$Anxiety, anxiety_data$Gender, sum)
by(anxiety_data$Anxiety, anxiety_data$Gender, stat.desc)
by(anxiety_data$Anxiety, anxiety_data$Gender, function(X) round(stat.desc(X, 2)))
